bind.description: IP address(es) Redis will bind to (space-separated for multiple). Use '0.0.0.0' to bind to all interfaces (⚠️ insecure unless firewall-protection is applied).

port.description: TCP port for non-TLS connections. Set to 0 if only using TLS.

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for client connections.

tls_port.description: TCP port for TLS-encrypted connections (used only if TLS is enabled).

tls_cert_file.description: Path to TLS certificate file (PEM format).

tls_key_file.description: Path to TLS private key file (PEM format).

tls_ca_cert_file.description: Path to CA certificate file for validating client certificates (optional).

tls_auth_clients.description: Require clients to present valid certificates (mTLS) when TLS is enabled.

daemonize.description: Run Redis as a background daemon (recommended for production).

pidfile.description: Path to PID file for process management.

loglevel.description: Verbosity of logs. Options: debug, verbose, notice, warning.

logfile.description: Path to log file. Use '-' to log to stderr.

save_intervals.description: RDB snapshot schedule: list of [seconds, changes] pairs. Set empty list [] to disable RDB.

dir.description: Working directory for RDB/AOF files and persistence data.

maxmemory.description: Maximum memory Redis can use (e.g., '2gb', '512mb', '0' = unlimited). Required for eviction policies to take effect.

maxmemory_policy.description: Eviction policy when maxmemory is reached (e.g., allkeys-lru, volatile-ttl, allkeys-random).

maxmemory_samples.description: Number of samples for LRU and TTL eviction algorithms. Higher = more accuracy, more CPU.

maxclients.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections.

requirepass.description: Password required for client authentication (⚠️ avoid in plaintext in production — use ACLs instead).

masterauth.description: Password used when authenticating to a master (for replication).

replicaof.description: Master node to replicate from in format 'host port'. Empty string = standalone/master.

replica_announce_ip.description: Public IP to announce to clients as this replica's address (e.g., for NAT/containers).

replica_announce_port.description: Public port to announce as this replica's port (when replica-announce-ip is set).

latency_monitor_threshold.description: Log events taking ≥ this many milliseconds (0 = disabled).

slowlog_log_slower_than.description: Log commands taking ≥ this many microseconds (e.g., 10000 = 10ms). Set to 0 to log all commands.

slowlog_max_len.description: Maximum number of entries kept in slowlog.

notify_keyspace_events.description: Enable pub/sub for key events (e.g., 'AKE' = all events; empty = disabled).

tcp_backlog.description: TCP listen() backlog size (system-dependent max applies).

timeout.description: Close connection after this many seconds of inactivity (0 = no timeout).

tcp_keepalive.description: Send TCP keepalive packets every N seconds (0 = disable).

appendonly.description: Enable AOF persistence (recommended over RDB alone for durability).

appendfsync.description: Sync policy: always, everysec, no. Trade-off between durability & performance.

no_appendfsync_on_rewrite.description: Defer fsync during BGSAVE/AOF rewrite (improves latency but risks data loss in crash).

auto_aof_rewrite_percentage.description: Trigger AOF rewrite when size grows by this % over last rewrite.

auto_aof_rewrite_min_size.description: Minimum AOF size required to trigger rewrite (e.g., '64mb', '128mb').

aof_load_truncated.description: Load AOF even if it appears truncated (prevents startup failure on partial writes).

aof_use_rdb_preamble.description: Prefix AOF with RDB snapshot for faster load (recommended).

cluster_enabled.description: Enable Redis Cluster mode (requires multiple nodes).

cluster_config_file.description: Filename for cluster configuration (auto-generated, do not edit manually).

cluster_node_timeout.description: Cluster node timeout in milliseconds before marking a node as failed.

sentinel_mode.description: Enable Redis Sentinel mode for high availability (monitors masters/replicas).

sentinel_master_name.description: Name of the master instance to monitor.

sentinel_master_ip.description: IP address of the master to monitor (only used in Sentinel config).

sentinel_master_port.description: Port of the master to monitor.

sentinel_quorum.description: Number of Sentinels that must agree to detect a master failure.

extra_directives.description: Free-form additional config directives (for advanced tuning or vendor-specific features). Format: [{'key': 'directive', 'value': 'arg1 arg2'}].
